---
title: "Testing User Interactivity"
resources:
  - shinylive-sw.js
---

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true

from shiny import ui, render, App

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.input_text("name", "Batter Name:"),
    ui.input_text("year", "Batter Year:"),
    ui.output_text("result")
    style="width: 400px; height: 200px; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"
)

def server(input, output, session):
    @output
    @render.text
    def result():
        return f"Hello, {input.name()} from {input.year()}!"

app = App(app_ui,server)
```
